name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.0 degrees south of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 5 visits over 31 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 32 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 31 hours starting 2025-05-16, at wavelengths from 1.04 to 4.42 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
